specialRules.name: Stealth Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Stealth.

specialRules.name: Stealth Buff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Stealth once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Rending Mark
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Rending against once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Fortified Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Fortified.

specialRules.name: Precision Shooter Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get +1 to hit rolls when shooting.

specialRules.name: Defense Debuff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which gets -1 to defense rolls once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Bane when Shooting
specialRules.description: This model gets Bane when shooting.
